headline: KOSPI rises, but solar stocks plunge… U.S. benefit expectations couldn't stop it
summary: Solar stocks that surged in the first half on expectations of U.S. policy benefits are surrendering most of those gains in the second half. Analysts say the policy benefits have not yet translated into earnings.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark stock index, and solar manufacturers are a notable part of its listed universe. Expected policy benefits often drive valuations before they show up in reported profits.
